Container.Name: starbase
Container.Overview: Spreadsheets (StarSheets) and documents (StarDocs) you host yourself, familiar to anyone who uses Google Workspace. Your files are kept as ordinary .xlsx and .docx. The setup code for the first (owner's) account is in the container's log.

Config.Name: Files
Config.Description: Your spreadsheets and documents, versions and accounts

Config.Name: Backups
Config.Description: Optional: a share for Starbase's own encrypted backups (avatar › Backups… in the app)

Config.Name: Setup code
Config.Description: Optional: your own setup code for the owner's account (12+ characters). Empty: a random one is printed in the log

Config.Name: Where files are kept (shown in the app)
Config.Description: How the apps tell people where files are saved
